(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((comps (objects g 2))
                  (sorted (sort-by comps (lambda (o) (min-of snd (obj-cells o))))))
             (reduce (lambda (acc i)
                       (if (zero? (remainder i 2))
                           (recolor-cells acc (obj-cells (nth sorted i)) 4)
                           acc))
                     g
                     (range 0 (length sorted)))))))
